description: The structural read (S30 T5, D7/D8/CG7): one symbol, its direct edges BOTH directions, references only — no field in this answer can hold file content or prose. Four-state honesty at its purest: `found` shown here; the same method answers `ambiguous` with every candidate listed and none picked, `not-found` when the root has rows and the name matches none, and `not-built` when the root has no rows at all — a collapsed fourth state would let an un-indexed project read as an empty one. componentRoot is REQUIRED (T5 §5): there is no ambient root on the socket.
